leadText:
Pokémon: Master Quest is the fifth season of the dubbed version of the Pokémon animated series. It is the third and final dubbed season of . It follows the final adventures of , , and in the Johto region, from the Whirl Islands to the Johto League at Mt. Silver.

It originally aired as part of the 2002-2003 Saturday morning lineup. The season began with Around the Whirlpool, which originally aired on September 14, 2002, and ended with You're a Star, Larvitar!, which originally aired on September 6, 2003; it was later extended to include all of the episodes until the end of Pokémon the Series: Gold and Silver with Hoenn Alone!. This season skips EP250, which was banned from airing.

It is preceded by Pokémon: Johto League Champions and succeeded by Pokémon: Advanced, the first season of the dub of , which is based on the Generation III . This season is also the last of the 4Kids Entertainment dub to be produced at TAJ Productions.

==Blurb==
 
With the Olivine City Gym temporarily out of commission, our heroes are off to the Whirl Cup Competition—and Misty wants in on the action! Resuming their journey, they find that Jessie, James, and Meowth aren’t the only members of Team Rocket they need to worry about, though that dastardly trio still has a few tricks up their collective sleeve. After a heated battle with the final Gym Leader, Ash moves on to the Silver Conference, but does he have the mettle to take on his old rival, Gary?

==Trivia==
This is the first season to only have one voice director, Jason Bergenfeld.
This is the last season of to air in and before the release of , seven years later.
This is the last 4Kids-dubbed season to be produced at TAJ Productions.
This is the longest complete dub season, at 64 episodes.
There was a differently-colored version of the logo used on the Toonami Jetstream website. This variation of the logo was used until January 20, 2009.
The VIZ Media DVD release from 2016 additionally used an alternate version without the black outlines on the "Pokémon" logo.
